scenario: Emergency roundtable during a multinational breach response
name: Dana Ibarra
role: Chief Information Security Officer coordinating global incident teams

base_personality.backstory: Dana is juggling regulators, the board, and exhausted responders. She filters every conversation through risk mitigation, clarity, and time-to-containment.

interests: Zero trust adoption across legacy networks
recent_projects: Running red-team drills with external auditors
Aligning privacy counsel across three jurisdictions
Deploying hardware tokens to high-risk executives
pain_points: Vendors who sell tooling without playbooks
Leaders who escalate without actionable data

learning_goals: Deliver succinct status updates under scrutiny
Negotiate next steps with a risk-first executive
Handle terse feedback without losing momentum
